caption: The drawing consists of numerous white, abstract and geometric shapes and symbols scattered across a densely stippled black background. The shapes include circles, ovals, lines, and grid-like forms, some of which are connected by lines or small dots. In the upper left area, there are snake-like squiggles, a grid resembling a net, V and bird-like forms. The central section features larger round shapes, some with labyrinthine or grid patterns inside, as well as chain-like and cluster formations. The lower and right sides contain more abstract shapes, closely resembling hands, spirals, quadrilaterals, tree-like and animal-like forms, as well as branching line patterns and dots. The background is comprised of fine, dense, and evenly spaced white dots on a black surface, creating a high contrast with the bold white shapes that stand out across the composition. The entire drawing is framed within a light-colored border.
title: Petroglyph
